title: AI Transformation with Microsoft Copilot
tagline: Practical technology training for the work you do
hook: Lead Copilot transformation with clearer decisions and measurable outcomes
marketing_pitch: Give senior leaders a practical way to use Microsoft Copilot in their own decisions. Build a sourced board brief, a safe-use charter, a 30-seat pilot plan and a value scorecard, then decide whether to scale. The focus is executive judgment and business results.
description: AI Transformation with Microsoft Copilot is a three-day WSQ course for executives and senior managers. Participants use Microsoft 365 Copilot in Chat, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams and Excel to prepare strategic briefs, compare options, coordinate decisions and analyse business value. A synthetic organisation case lets them practise data-use boundaries, human approval, adoption leadership and evidence-based investment decisions. The course draws on the business-use themes of Microsoft AI Business Professional (AB-730) and the strategic planning themes of AB-100; it is not an exam-preparation course and does not require coding or agent development.
learning_outcomes: Develop technology implementation plans and business processes for Microsoft Copilot.
Develop control procedures for Microsoft Copilot to manage security.
Evaluate the integration of Microsoft Copilot to ensure alignment with business objectives.
Develop optimization plans for Microsoft Copilot to improve business operations.

topics.title: Set the Copilot Transformation Strategy and Lead by Example
Govern Copilot Use and Protect Business Decisions
Integrate Copilot into the Executive Operating Model
Measure Value, Scale Adoption and Report to the Board

mode: Physical classroom or synchronised Zoom; corporate training available
venue: 12 Woodlands Square #07-85/86/87, Woods Square Tower 1, Singapore 737715
assessment: Written assessment and practical performance assessment, one hour each, individual open book
who_should_attend: C-suite executives, business unit leaders, directors and senior managers who sponsor or govern Microsoft Copilot adoption.
certification: Certificate of Achievement from Tertiary Infotech Academy and, on meeting WSQ assessment and attendance requirements, SkillsFuture Singapore Statement of Attainment via OpenCerts.
